result:
I’d make the reality of other minds impossible to deny. Not telepathy—just a constant, visceral certainty that every other being’s inner life is as real as your own.

Almost every atrocity needs a moment where a person becomes an “it,” a number, a category, a problem. Remove that moment, and you don’t get a utopia—just a world where cruelty costs more than most people are willing to pay.
